title: Lamb Wrap Italian Style
description: A hearty Italian-inspired lamb wrap filled with fresh vegetables and herbs.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together salt, pepper, and lamb shoulder. Let marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Remove lamb from marinade and place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Bake for 15-20 minutes or until cooked through.
Warm Italian flatbread wraps by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Spread 2 tablespoons of Mediterranean hummus on each wrap.
Add sliced lamb, cucumber, red bell pepper, and chopped parsley on top of the hummus.
Sprinkle crumbled feta cheese on top (if using).
Fold wrap in half and serve immediately.
